rationale: Control arm, no atlas. Weights-only logit lens over MLP down_proj columns (reading dir = E*(1+g_final)) found 'Wait' token neurons L17n1915, L18n881, L20n405, L22n573. G1 showed they fire NEGATIVELY in thinking context: negating them gave 'wait wait ...' (acc 0). So the right edit amplifies only their Wait-token component (u = Wait/wait unembedding dir, cols=[neuron], alpha<0), which is NoWait-like suppression. A closure boost amplifies the L23 MLP write along the </think> unembedding dir (cols=None, alpha<0). Gen attribution on 16 problems (base acc .06, cut 1.0): close-only .19/cut .81 (loops persist), NoWait-only .44/cut .50 (Wait-free bullet loops remain), combined .50/.31 (a=-6,-0.8), .44/.00 (a=-6,-1.5, 1110 tok), and .69/.125 (a=-9,-1.1, 2036 tok, 10 rescues, 0 losses). #1 074537_659 is the best gen result, with probe metrics prod +0.017, close +1.13 (slightly over the soft +1), and neutral -0.003. #2 062959_102 meets every probe limit and gives more thinking room, which may help at a 12k cap. #3 064104_047 always finishes but its thinking is short.
